summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by HSBC Holdings plc reporting the grant of conditional awards under the HSBC Share Plan 2011 to employees and former employees. On 6 May 2026, the company granted awards for 182,795 ordinary shares at a purchase price of GBP 0, with vesting typically over three years and retention periods. No performance targets apply as these are deferred bonus awards to meet UK regulatory requirements. There is no acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation event; it is a routine equity grant disclosure under Hong Kong listing rules.
